title: [main] bug 642743 - Change behavior of OnValidate trigger of "EU 3-Party Intermed. Role CZL" field
summary: When the EU 3-Party Intermediary field is deactivated in sales or purchase document headers, the EU 3-Party Trade field is now also deactivated instead of remaining active.
key_points: Fixed inconsistent validation behavior where setting EU 3-Party Intermediary to false did not clear the EU 3-Party Trade field
Ensures both fields stay synchronized during activation and deactivation
Applied to both Sales and Purchase document headers in the Czech localization
quote: When the EU 3-Party - Intermediary field in the document header is deactivated, the system does not deactivate the EU 3-Party Trade field
